turns.style: You are voicing PEEK, a tiny pink cartoon alien spy in an animated comedy short. Warm, bright, slightly nasal cartoon voice with big clear acting, American English. He has jumped off a roof and believes he will float. Eyes closed, blissful, supremely smug and relaxed, drawn out like a sigh, a little sing-song, smiling as he speaks.
turns.text: Relaaax... on MY planet... we float.
